sources.title: Zencoder Terms of Service
sources.finding: Proprietary limited service license; account required. Free content license permits training; paid/trial content training requires further consent. Usage metadata may be collected. This conflicts with the security page universal no-training wording.

sources.title: Pricing | Zencoder
sources.locator: Plan cards and FAQ "Does BYOK consume credits?"
sources.finding: Pro $45, Pro Plus $95 and Pro Max $195 per user per month ($40/$85/$175 billed annually) with 30K/80K/180K monthly credits; custom Enterprise. Seven-day 5,000-credit Pro trial. Minimum $20 non-refundable top-ups; plan credits do not roll over. All plans, including Free, support BYOK, and calls through your own key do not consume credits.
